string.text: Minimum clan relations required to allow marriage between clans. Base game uses -50. Default is -25.
When enabled, adds a matrilineal marriage option to the barter screen. Matrilineal means the husband joins the wife's clan instead of the default (wife joins husband's clan).
Minimum gold value for marriage barter. Ensures a baseline cost regardless of other factors. Default is 2500.
Base gold value for marriage transactions. This is adjusted by hero value, clan tier, and relations. Default is 15000.
How much the hero's combat/leadership value affects marriage cost. 0 = no effect, 1 = full effect. Default is 0.5.
Gold value per clan tier difference. Higher tier clan losing a member = more compensation. Default is 3000.
Additional cost multiplier when marrying a companion to a lord (lord becomes wanderer). 1.25 = 25% extra cost. Default is 1.25.
Cost multiplier for matrilineal option. Values below 1 reduce cost, above 1 increase it. Default is 1.0.
